保存分数与理由" style="rounded=1;fillColor=#E7F6EC;strokeColor=#8BCB9F;whiteSpace=wrap;html=0;fontFamily=Arial;fontSize=16;fontColor=#1B1F24;" vertex="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" x="580" y="400" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-1" source="model" target="valid" value="" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-2" source="valid" target="error" value="否" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-3" source="valid" target="norm" value="是" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0.5;exitY=1;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-4" source="norm" target="threshold" value="有效分数" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell><mxCell id="edge-5" source="threshold" target="pass" value="是" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;strokeColor=#687D93;fontSize=13;labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF;exitX=0;exitY=0.5;entryX=0.5;entryY=0;" edge="1" parent="1"><mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel>
